name: braintrust
summary: I successfully installed the Braintrust SDK and autoevals scorers in both JavaScript and Python, created the eval file from the quickstart, and demonstrated that the eval logic runs and computes scores. Using the Python SDK with `no_send_logs=True` (an offline mode not mentioned in the quickstart), I got real output: **77.78% 'Levenshtein' score** with a score of 1.0 for the "Foo" case and 0.5555555555555556 for the "Bar" case. What blocked completion was that the Braintrust API (api.braintrust.dev) was unreachable from the sandbox—every TLS handshake was reset by peer, so the SDK could not log in or upload results. The JavaScript quickstart path (`npx braintrust eval`) failed with the same network error, and I had to deviate from the docs by switching to Python and running offline to get any scores at all.

env_ready.evidence: node --version returned v25.9.0 and npm --version returned 11.12.1

installed.evidence: npm install braintrust autoevals returned added 140 packages in 11s

configured.evidence: echo "API key set: ${BRAINTRUST_API_KEY:+yes}" returned API key set: yes

first_call.evidence: BRAINTRUST_API_KEY="$BRAINTRUST_API_KEY" npx braintrust eval tutorial.eval.ts exited with code 1 and output TypeError: fetch failed

verified.evidence: The quickstart's JS eval command failed with TypeError: fetch failed; scores were only produced later by deviating to Python with no_send_logs=True

friction.where: Braintrust API endpoint unreachable from sandbox
friction.detail: curl -v https://api.braintrust.dev returned curl: (35) Recv failure: Connection reset by peer

friction.where: JavaScript quickstart CLI fails cryptically when API is unreachable
friction.detail: npx braintrust eval tutorial.eval.ts produced only TypeError: fetch failed with no actionable remediation
curl -vL https://www.braintrust.dev/docs/start returned TLS connect error: Connection reset by peer

friction.where: Offline/local eval mode not mentioned in JS quickstart README
friction.detail: README shows only BRAINTRUST_API_KEY=<YOUR_API_KEY> npx braintrust eval tutorial.eval.ts with no --no-send-logs or offline flag

friction.where: Python SDK no_send_logs escape hatch is undocumented in the fetched quickstart
friction.detail: agent note: Using the Python SDK with no_send_logs=True (an offline mode not mentioned in the quickstart)
